target: The flowering stem (PO:0009047) has few or reduced cauline leaves (PO:0000013); nothing is absent. The ternate leaves are the basal leaves, leaf PO:0025034 ternately compound

target: Nothing is absent and no fruit annotation should be made. Capsules were simply not collected. The 'dark-violet' statement probably belongs to the perianth (calyx tube or limb) rather than to the fruit; check the source
